title: FOMC rate decision tomorrow, what to expect!

observed_trades.setup: Holding IBIT through the Clarity Act failing, as long as it stays above the 200 SMA.
observed_trades.stop: hold so long as it is above the 200 simple moving average
observed_trades.quote: I own IBIT. Of course, I didn't love the action, but I continued to hold so long as you are above the 200 simple moving average
observed_trades.notes: Repeated at 09:29: 'I continue like I said to own some IBIT'.

observed_trades.setup: Peeling into strength in a choppy tape; took a fifth off the day before.
observed_trades.quote: push today and I'm like, okay, yesterday I took a fifth of my position off
observed_trades.notes: Ticker named just before ('even Octa', 16:07). 'I didn't have a big position to begin with'. Also 'I still own uh Octa' (05:10) and 'I have octa and this is working nice little day two move' (09:54).

observed_trades.setup: On today's push he trimmed again, a smaller piece.
observed_trades.size: another 10% of what I have left
observed_trades.quote: Today I'm going to take off another 10% of what I have left off
observed_trades.notes: Told in the historical present ('I'm like ... Today I'm going to take off'), so read as a trim he made today; ticker named at 16:07 ('even Octa').

observed_trades.setup: Bought the pullback; it held the 20-day and gapped back above the 50.
observed_trades.quote: I bought AMD yesterday on this little pullback and I got to give AMD some credit

observed_trades.setup: Planned to trim into ~515, did not get it; trimmed when it lost VWAP.
observed_trades.quote: It loses VWAP. I then take some off like 505ish if I'm not mistaken
observed_trades.notes: Price is approximate ('like 505ish if I'm not mistaken'). Watched it at 510-513 hoping for 515.

observed_trades.setup: Existing GDX short going sideways; plans to cover another small piece into the 200-day or ahead of the Fed decision.
observed_trades.quote: I still have my GDX short and you know, you're just doing a bunch of uh nothing here
observed_trades.notes: 'cover off another little piece' implies part was already covered, hence position_after partial. Plan to cover is not logged as a row. Whether the short is in GDX itself or an inverse product is not said.

observed_trades.setup: Recounts a Micron position he 'had really well' the prior Thursday as an example of having to take profits quickly.
observed_trades.quote: a name like Micron where I thought I had it really well last Thursday
observed_trades.notes: Unclear whether Thursday was the entry day or just the day the position looked good, and 'last Thursday' could be 9/10 or 9/3 - fill_date_stated left blank. Followed by two trims and a cut on Friday.

observed_trades.setup: Trimmed a little into the push.
observed_trades.quote: it started to push nicely. I took a little trim.
observed_trades.notes: First of two trims; day not stated (between 'last Thursday' and Friday). Ticker in the preceding sentence.

observed_trades.quote: I took another little trim and then ultimately
observed_trades.notes: Second of two trims; day not stated.

observed_trades.setup: Cut the remainder on Friday; had he not, the position would now be red.
observed_trades.quote: if I didn't cut it on Friday, right, I'd be red on the position right now
observed_trades.notes: Counterfactual phrasing ('if I didn't cut it on Friday') read as: he cut it Friday. Friday before the Tue 9/15 session = 9/11.

observed_trades.setup: An oil refiner he owned from February at a 185 cost basis and no longer holds; now too extended (6.5x ATR above the 50) to re-buy.
observed_trades.quote: If I could go back to February um and get my 185 cost basis back, boy, I'd love it
observed_trades.notes: Chart being shown is not identified: the sentence follows 'if you bought yourself VLOO, if you bought yourself MPC'. Ticker left '?' (VLO or MPC).

observed_trades.setup: States he no longer owns the February energy position.
observed_trades.quote: I wish I still owned it from lower I no longer own it
observed_trades.notes: Exit date and price not given. Same unidentified refiner (VLO or MPC) as the entry row.
